guides.title: 工程檔案：關鍵數據、年代、規範與案例
guides.titleEn: Engineering dossier: key figures, timeline, codes and landmarks
guides.concept: 微型隧道的面壓、泥水輸送與管節受力。本頁區分公開工程資料與明示的教學假設；數值只用於學習比較，不是設計值。
guides.conceptEn: Microtunnel face pressure, slurry transport and pipe loading. This dossier distinguishes public project facts from explicitly labelled teaching assumptions; figures are for learning comparisons, not design values.
facts: 假想檢核 1：面壓合力與地下水邊界；uniformResultant=250 kPa*pi*(1.5 m)^2/4=441.8 kN
假想檢核 2：泥漿濃度與固體平衡；Inputs densities rhoMix=1300, rhoCarrier=1100, rhoSolid=2650 kg/m3; Cv=(rhoMix-rhoCarrier)/(rhoSolid-rhoCarrier)=(1300-1100)/(2650-1100)=0.1290; Qs=0.050 m3/s*Cv=0.00645 m3/s
假想檢核 3：開挖體積與進尺一致性；theoreticalVolume=pi*(1.5 m)^2/4*0.50 m=0.8836 m3
假想檢核 4：管壁摩阻與長度累積；skinResistance=tau*pi*D*L=5 kPa*pi*1.5 m*100 m=2356 kN
假想檢核 5：接頭傳力與墊材接觸；jointBearing=1200 kN/0.30 m2=4000 kPa=4 MPa
假想檢核 6：雷射坡度與基準傳遞；gradeDrop=slope*length=0.003*100 m=0.30 m
CEDD 岩洞指南第二版出版於 2018 年，並非本課的實測報告
FHWA 官方典藏將隧道土木手冊出版日期記為 2009 年
factsEn: Assumed check 1: Face-pressure resultant and groundwater boundary; uniformResultant=250 kPa*pi*(1.5 m)^2/4=441.8 kN

Assumed check 2: Slurry concentration and solids balance; Inputs densities rhoMix=1300, rhoCarrier=1100, rhoSolid=2650 kg/m3; Cv=(rhoMix-rhoCarrier)/(rhoSolid-rhoCarrier)=(1300-1100)/(2650-1100)=0.1290; Qs=0.050 m3/s*Cv=0.00645 m3/s
Assumed check 3: Excavated volume and advance consistency; theoreticalVolume=pi*(1.5 m)^2/4*0.50 m=0.8836 m3
Assumed check 4: Pipe skin friction and length accumulation; skinResistance=tau*pi*D*L=5 kPa*pi*1.5 m*100 m=2356 kN
Assumed check 5: Joint load transfer and packer contact; jointBearing=1200 kN/0.30 m2=4000 kPa=4 MPa
Assumed check 6: Laser grade and datum transfer; gradeDrop=slope*length=0.003*100 m=0.30 m
CEDD issued its second cavern guide in 2018; it is not a measurement report for these examples
The FHWA official archive dates the civil tunnel manual to 2009
timeline: 1992　CEDD 出版岩洞工程指南第一版，建立公開技術框架
2009　FHWA 隧道土木手冊彙整多類開挖及襯砌工法
2018　CEDD 第二版岩洞指南更新地層與支護評估脈絡
timelineEn: 1992 — CEDD publishes its first cavern-engineering guide as a public technical framework
2009 — The FHWA civil tunnel manual consolidates excavation and lining methods
2018 — The second CEDD cavern guide updates ground and support assessment
codes: FHWA 道路隧道設計與施工土木技術手冊
CEDD 岩土指南第四冊：岩洞工程第二版
codesEn: FHWA Technical Manual for Design and Construction of Road Tunnels - Civil Elements
CEDD Geoguide 4: Guide to Cavern Engineering second edition
landmarks: 一般城市管線走廊（教學場景，非指定工程）
假想接收井（邊界比較，非指定工程）
landmarksEn: Generic urban utility corridor (teaching scenario, not a named project)
Hypothetical receiving shaft (boundary comparison, not a named project)
procedure: 把關鍵數據與本課算例逐項對照，標出哪些是公開工程數據、哪些是教學假設。
沿著工程時間軸，標出設計、施工、事件與維護改造的關鍵決策點，說明每個決策改變了哪一條系統路徑或檢核。
對照列出的規範與標準，找出本課試驗或允收步驟對應的條款類型，並註明版本與適用地區。
從代表工程中選一個與本課比較，列出埋深或斷面、地質水文、支護系統與施工方法的差異。
procedureEn: Compare the key figures with this course's worked example and mark which are public project data and which are teaching assumptions.
Along the timeline, mark the key design, construction, event and retrofit decisions and say which system path or check each one changed.
Against the listed codes and standards, find the kind of clause behind this course's tests or acceptance steps, noting edition and jurisdiction.
Pick one landmark project to compare with this course and list differences in depth or section, ground and groundwater, support system and construction method.
pitfalls: 把四捨五入的公開數據當成設計值或允收值使用。
沒有確認規範版本、適用地區與荷載組合就直接套用另一國的條文。
pitfallsEn: Using rounded public figures as design or acceptance values.
Applying another country's clauses without checking edition, jurisdiction and load combinations.

guides.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

guides.title: 機制、算例與驗證：微型隧道機頂管
guides.titleEn: Mechanisms, calculations and verification: Microtunneling pipe jacking
guides.concept: 本課以微型隧道的面壓、泥水輸送與管節受力為主線，從面壓合力與地下水邊界與泥漿濃度與固體平衡建立系統邊界，再把接頭傳力與墊材接觸、泥水管路損失與流變連到成品管線水密與紀錄。泥水壓力、土體應力和管節結構採不同邊界；簡化水力及平均承壓均不能直接設定設備參數。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
guides.conceptEn: This course focuses on microtunnel face pressure, slurry transport and pipe loading. It begins with Face-pressure resultant and groundwater boundary and Slurry concentration and solids balance, links Joint load transfer and packer contact and Slurry-line loss and rheology, and ends with Finished-pipeline tightness and records. Slurry pressure, ground stress and pipe structure use distinct boundaries; simplified hydraulics and average bearing cannot directly set equipment parameters. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.
procedure: 泥水面壓需與土骨架及孔隙水的穩定條件共同評估，壓力乘圓面積只是作用合力。高程差使掌子面上下水壓不同，局部滲透又影響有效應力；不能將這個合力當成面前土體所需支護的完整判準。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將艙壓感測高程、地下水頭及地層剖面對應；若出現使用不同高程壓力直接比較，誤判面前支護裕度，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
回流密度同時受輸入載液、挖出固體及混入水影響，需用兩相質量體積平衡估固體濃度。輸入載液若已有固體就不能把全部回流固體當新增出土；沉積與密度計偏差也會使瞬時資料不能閉合長時段土量。 判別這個機制時，應觀察同步比較進回流密度、流量與分離固體質量；若出現循環載液原有固體被重複計為出土，造成虛假超挖警訊，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
理論切削體積由切削外徑及實際進尺決定，並非成品管內徑。超挖與面前土體流入會使移除量增加，而含水、膨鬆及分離滯留使地面量測不直接等於原位量；應保留體積換算及輸送延遲。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將刀盤外徑、進尺時戳與延遲修正出土量比對；若出現忽略回流延遲把前段出土誤配後段進尺，掩蓋局部流失，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
管列軸力沿長度累積，摩阻取決於地層接觸、潤滑與有效應力，前端還有切削與面壓阻力。均勻剪應力模型僅可看長度敏感度，接頭錯位和停機黏著可能使局部阻力突升；總推力不能直接反推唯一摩阻值。 判別這個機制時，應觀察對照各段推力增量、潤滑紀錄與停機時間；若出現摩阻集中在局部失潤滑段，均勻模型低估該處管節負荷，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
頂管接頭透過端面與墊材傳遞壓力，曲線、偏轉和端面不平會縮小有效接觸面。墊材壓縮改變接觸分布而非只平均分力；平均承壓偏低仍可能發生邊緣剝落，需與接頭角差及材料壓縮特性一起檢查。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較接頭角差、墊材壓痕及管端裂縫位置；若出現接頭一側失去接觸使另一側壓碎，總推力仍低於名義額定，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
重力管線的坡度依賴長距高程一致性，雷射線、機頭姿態及管列中心線是不同量。折射、支架位移和發射點重設會造成共同偏差，不能靠同一儀器重複讀值排除；接收井閉合與獨立水準可提供外部檢核。 判別這個機制時，應觀察核對雷射基準、獨立水準及管底實測高程；若出現發射架位移使整段同向偏移，機內導向仍顯示接近目標，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
輸送管的壓損受流速、管徑、彎頭及泥漿流變影響，清水形式的摩擦係數不能任意套用高濃度漿體。等效牛頓流體算例只是量級比較，沉積還會改變有效管徑；泵端壓力不能代表機頭艙壓。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較管路分段壓差、流量與泥漿流變及沉積檢查；若出現把泵壓上升當成面壓增加，漏掉管內堵塞與輸送衰退，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
橫向沉陷槽積分可估每延米地表體積損失，但槽寬、最大沉陷與基準誤差需共同擬合。高斯形只是特定土層情境的近似，建物、地下水和多管線互動可破壞對稱；地表損失也不必等於當時出土超量。 判別這個機制時，應觀察用橫向測線殘差與長期基準點穩定性檢驗槽形；若出現只量中心點就套固定槽寬，錯估受影響區域與體積損失，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
機頭到達接收井時，土體及井壁的水密邊界會改變，開口的水壓合力需用對應水頭計算。井內外水位、封口和地層滲透共同決定流動風險；靜水力算例不能代替經核定的接收與隔離設計。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將接收開口高程、內外水位及封口試驗資料對齊；若出現接收前水位升高未更新壓差，原有封口假設失效，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
完成頂進後的接頭水密與施工時抗推力是兩種性能，局部擦傷或墊圈位移可能未在推力曲線顯現。流量試驗需聲明測段、水頭及穩定時間，並區分管體、接頭和端部封堵；全線平均值不能掩蓋關鍵局部漏點。 判別這個機制時，應觀察核對試驗水頭、測段界線與逐接頭影像紀錄；若出現端部試驗封堵漏水被誤判管線失效，或局部漏點被全線平均隱藏，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
procedureEn: Slurry face pressure must be assessed with soil-skeleton and pore-water stability; pressure times circular area is only a resultant. Elevation creates vertical pressure variation and seepage changes effective stress. This resultant alone does not establish the support needed for the ground ahead of the machine. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Relate chamber-pressure sensor elevation to groundwater head and ground profile. If comparing pressures at different elevations directly misjudges face-support margin, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

Return density depends on carrier fluid, excavated solids and incoming water, requiring two-phase balance. Solids already present in the feed cannot be counted as newly excavated ground. Deposition and density-meter bias further prevent instantaneous readings from closing a long-period excavation balance. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare synchronized feed and return density, flow and separated-solids mass. If recirculated carrier solids are counted again as excavation and create a false overbreak signal, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

Theoretical cut volume uses cutter diameter and actual advance rather than finished internal diameter. Overcut and face inflow increase removal, while moisture, bulking and separator retention alter surface measurements. Preserve conversion assumptions and transport delay when reconciling excavated volume with progress. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare cutter diameter and advance timestamps with delay-corrected spoil volume. If ignoring return delay assigns earlier spoil to later advance and hides local loss, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

Axial pipe force accumulates along the drive, with friction controlled by contact, lubrication and effective stress in addition to front resistance. Uniform shear illustrates length sensitivity only. Misalignment and stoppage adhesion can create local increases, so total thrust does not identify a unique friction value. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare thrust increments by segment with lubrication records and stoppage duration. If friction concentrates in a poorly lubricated section and a uniform model understates local pipe loading, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

Pipe joints transmit thrust through end faces and packers, while curvature, deflection and unevenness reduce effective contact. Packer compression redistributes contact rather than merely averaging force. Low mean stress can coexist with edge spalling, requiring checks against joint angle and packer compression characteristics. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare joint angularity, packer impressions and pipe-end crack locations. If loss of contact on one side crushes the opposite edge despite thrust below the nominal rating, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

Gravity pipelines depend on consistent elevation over distance; laser line, machine attitude and pipe centerline differ. Refraction, mount movement and transmitter resets introduce shared bias that repeated readings cannot remove. Receiving-shaft closure and independent leveling provide external checks on the transferred datum. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Check laser reference, independent leveling and measured pipe-invert elevation. If transmitter-mount movement shifts a whole drive while onboard guidance still reports near-target position, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

Transport losses depend on velocity, diameter, fittings and slurry rheology; a water friction factor cannot be assumed for concentrated slurry. An equivalent-Newtonian example is a scale check, while deposition changes effective diameter. Pump discharge pressure does not directly represent face-chamber pressure. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare sectional pressure loss, flow and slurry rheology with deposition checks. If treating rising pump pressure as rising face pressure misses blockage and reduced transport, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

Integrating a transverse settlement trough estimates surface volume loss per unit length, requiring joint assessment of width, peak and datum error. A Gaussian is an approximation for particular ground conditions; buildings, groundwater and adjacent drives can break symmetry. Surface loss need not equal contemporaneous excess spoil. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Test the trough fit against transverse residuals and stable long-term benchmarks. If measuring only the center and imposing a fixed width misestimates affected area and volume loss, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

Arrival changes groundwater boundaries at the shaft wall and ground interface; calculate opening force using the relevant head. Internal and external levels, seals and permeability jointly determine inflow risk. A hydrostatic force example does not replace an approved reception and isolation design. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Align receiving-opening elevation, internal and external levels and seal-test evidence. If a pre-arrival water-level rise invalidates the pressure difference assumed for the seal, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

Post-jacking joint tightness differs from thrust resistance, and damaged or displaced seals may leave no clear thrust signature. Flow tests need defined section, head and stabilization time and must distinguish pipes, joints and end closures. An overall average cannot conceal critical localized leakage. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Check test head, section boundaries and images indexed to individual joints. If a leaking test closure is mistaken for pipe failure or overall averaging hides a local leak, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
evidence: 將將艙壓感測高程、地下水頭及地層剖面對應列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現使用不同高程壓力直接比較，誤判面前支護裕度，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
將同步比較進回流密度、流量與分離固體質量列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現循環載液原有固體被重複計為出土，造成虛假超挖警訊，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
將將刀盤外徑、進尺時戳與延遲修正出土量比對列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現忽略回流延遲把前段出土誤配後段進尺，掩蓋局部流失，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
將對照各段推力增量、潤滑紀錄與停機時間列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現摩阻集中在局部失潤滑段，均勻模型低估該處管節負荷，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
將比較接頭角差、墊材壓痕及管端裂縫位置列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現接頭一側失去接觸使另一側壓碎，總推力仍低於名義額定，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
evidenceEn: Apply the following check at handover: Relate chamber-pressure sensor elevation to groundwater head and ground profile. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If comparing pressures at different elevations directly misjudges face-support margin, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

Apply the following check at handover: Compare synchronized feed and return density, flow and separated-solids mass. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If recirculated carrier solids are counted again as excavation and create a false overbreak signal, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

Apply the following check at handover: Compare cutter diameter and advance timestamps with delay-corrected spoil volume. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If ignoring return delay assigns earlier spoil to later advance and hides local loss, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

Apply the following check at handover: Compare thrust increments by segment with lubrication records and stoppage duration. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If friction concentrates in a poorly lubricated section and a uniform model understates local pipe loading, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

Apply the following check at handover: Compare joint angularity, packer impressions and pipe-end crack locations. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If loss of contact on one side crushes the opposite edge despite thrust below the nominal rating, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
pitfalls: 使用不同高程壓力直接比較，誤判面前支護裕度。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將艙壓感測高程、地下水頭及地層剖面對應，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
忽略回流延遲把前段出土誤配後段進尺，掩蓋局部流失。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將刀盤外徑、進尺時戳與延遲修正出土量比對，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
接頭一側失去接觸使另一側壓碎，總推力仍低於名義額定。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較接頭角差、墊材壓痕及管端裂縫位置，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
把泵壓上升當成面壓增加，漏掉管內堵塞與輸送衰退。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較管路分段壓差、流量與泥漿流變及沉積檢查，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
接收前水位升高未更新壓差，原有封口假設失效。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將接收開口高程、內外水位及封口試驗資料對齊，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
pitfallsEn: Comparing pressures at different elevations directly misjudges face-support margin. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to relate chamber-pressure sensor elevation to groundwater head and ground profile to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

Ignoring return delay assigns earlier spoil to later advance and hides local loss. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare cutter diameter and advance timestamps with delay-corrected spoil volume to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

Loss of contact on one side crushes the opposite edge despite thrust below the nominal rating. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare joint angularity, packer impressions and pipe-end crack locations to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

Treating rising pump pressure as rising face pressure misses blockage and reduced transport. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare sectional pressure loss, flow and slurry rheology with deposition checks to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

A pre-arrival water-level rise invalidates the pressure difference assumed for the seal. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to align receiving-opening elevation, internal and external levels and seal-test evidence to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

related.title: 頂管中繼推進站
related.transfer: 可遷移「面壓合力與地下水邊界」與「泥水管路損失與流變」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；頂管中繼推進站的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Face-pressure resultant and groundwater boundary" and "Slurry-line loss and rheology" transfer, while ground conditions, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Intermediate jacking stations must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦微型隧道的面壓、泥水輸送與管節受力；頂管中繼推進站則以頂管中繼站的分段受力、行程相容與局部接觸為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on microtunnel face pressure, slurry transport and pipe loading; Intermediate jacking stations centres on intermediate-jacking segment forces, stroke compatibility and local contact, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「面壓合力與地下水邊界」與「分段推力與反力連續」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到頂管中繼推進站，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「曲線管列與徑向作用」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Face-pressure resultant and groundwater boundary” and “Segment thrust and reaction continuity”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Intermediate jacking stations, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Curved pipe strings and radial action", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 微型隧道機頂管
history.text: 本課討論的微型隧道的面壓、泥水輸送與管節受力，反映地下工程由單一構件強度走向地層、施工時序與維護共同驗證的發展。泥水壓力、土體應力和管節結構採不同邊界；簡化水力及平均承壓均不能直接設定設備參數。 1992 年 CEDD 岩洞指南初版、2009 年 FHWA 隧道土木手冊及 2018 年岩洞指南第二版提供公開閱讀脈絡。FHWA 公開章節區分 HDD、頂管與微型隧道，PJA 資料提供管列荷載與公差的閱讀脈絡；城市管線走廊為假想場景，本課不主張取得其專有圖說或現場數據，只重建公開原理。
history.textEn: The focus on microtunnel face pressure, slurry transport and pipe loading reflects the development from isolated member strength toward combined ground, sequence and maintenance verification. Slurry pressure, ground stress and pipe structure use distinct boundaries; simplified hydraulics and average bearing cannot directly set equipment parameters. The 1992 first CEDD cavern guide, 2009 FHWA civil tunnel manual and 2018 second cavern-guide edition provide public context. FHWA distinguishes HDD, pipe jacking and microtunneling; PJA provides reading context for pipe loads and tolerances. The urban utility corridor is a hypothetical setting. This course claims no proprietary drawings or field data and reconstructs public principles.
